SELECT site_name AS "siteName", shift, CASE WHEN COUNT(CASE WHEN record_status = 'CREATED' THEN 1 END) > 0 THEN 'PENDING_SHIFT_CONFIRM' ELSE 'SHIFT_CONFIRMED' END AS status FROM lqc_records WHERE TRUNC(check_date) = TRUNC(#{checkDate,jdbcType=DATE}) GROUP BY site_name, shift

SELECT lr.lot_name AS "lotName", lr.product_pn AS "productPn", lr.total_qty AS "totalQty", lr.sample_qty AS "sampleQty", lr.total_defect_qty AS "totalDefectQty", ld.defect_name AS "defectName", ld.defect_qty AS "defectQty", u1.fullname AS "inspectorFullname", u2.fullname AS "shiftConfirmerFullname" FROM lqc_records lr LEFT JOIN lqc_record_details ld ON lr.id = ld.record_id LEFT JOIN USERPROFILE u1 ON lr.inspector_username = u1.username LEFT JOIN USERPROFILE u2 ON lr.shift_confirmed_by = u2.username WHERE TRUNC(lr.check_date) = TRUNC(#{checkDate, jdbcType=DATE}) AND lr.site_name = #{siteName, jdbcType=VARCHAR}
AND lr.shift = #{shift, jdbcType=VARCHAR}

SELECT site_name AS "siteName", record_status AS "recordStatus", COUNT(*) AS "statusCount" FROM lqc_records WHERE TRUNC(check_date) = TRUNC(#{checkDate,jdbcType=DATE}) GROUP BY site_name, record_status
mapper.update: UPDATE lqc_records SET total_qty = #{totalQty, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, sample_qty = #{sampleQty, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, total_defect_qty = #{totalDefectQty, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, last_updated_by = #{lastUpdatedBy, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, last_update_date = SYSDATE, attribute1 = #{attribute1, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, attribute2 = #{attribute2, jdbcType=VARCHAR} WHERE id = #{id, jdbcType=VARCHAR}
